notes.title: Pinecone Game: Albion
notes.content:
So, you are probably wondering what Albion is mentioned at the end of the final update of Pinecone Game.

It's time to lift the veil of secrecy and announce that the development of a sequel to Pinecone Game called Pinecone Game: Albion has been underway for some time.

During the work on Pinecone Game, many different ideas that are already difficult to fit into the original game were born, and therefore it was decided to make a sequel.

The essence of the game will still be to collect pinecones and throw them into a well, but the process of finding pinecones will become more difficult and interesting. The game world will be divided into regions, in each of which the player will have to go through a separate adventure full of secrets and challenges.

In addition to the single-player campaign, there are also plans to add two multiplayer modes to the game:
[list]
[*] "Seeker's Lair" - will allow the player to become the owner of their own flying island, which can be furnished with relics found in adventures to the envy of friends and enemies.
[*] "Expedition" - will allow you to go to the most hidden and unstable corners of the world and explore them in search of pinecones together with several other Seekers.
[/list]
It is planned to release the game in early access. Regions for the single-player campaign will be added gradually, at the start of the game at least two regions will be available [spoiler](as well as one or more secret ones)[/spoiler]. Initially, the game will be released for PC on Steam, but in the future there is a possibility of porting it to other devices and platforms.

At the moment, Pinecone Game: Albion is in the process of developing the architecture and game mechanics of the single-player campaign.

The original Pinecone Game will continue to work. There will be no more content updates, but we will continue to release patches if any bugs are found.

Also, players who have achieved certain success in the Pinecone Game will receive various bonuses in Albion, so stay tuned and keep throwing pinecones into the well.

notes.title: THE FINAL UPDATE
notes.content:
After throwing the last pinecone into the well, you notice that everything is not as usual. It seems that it is time to leave this place.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41653621/bd6035652f4d1321937506d2f064f8df2f0c28f8.gif[/img]

* the final update content is only available to players who have thrown 365 or more pinecones into the well

notes.title: Update - 09.28.2024
notes.content:
[list]
[*] In honor of several players reached the score of 1000 pinecones, we decided to add a special reward into the game: now every player who managed to reach such an impressive number will receive a "Millennium" statuette, which will be a great decoration for the flying island.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41653621/f0e64b05915ec3ec96f1ad9f46cfd12cb200ea3c.png[/img]

This statuette can be obtained in the in-game store (you will need to restart the game after reaching 1000 pinecones). Player named [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198085238363]amossong[/url], as the first who reached the 1000 pinecones mark, will receive a special personalized statuette.

[*] Now every time you throw a pinecone into the well, your account in the in-game store will be replenished by 1 pinecoin.

[/list]

notes.content: The connection between the game server and the Steam servers has been broken. Communication has been restored. All pinecones thrown during the existence of the error have been saved - the score in the table will be updated to the current one at the next throw.
